answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because glacier only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any ember approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
